# Twilight Zone Permanent Lighting — Full content index

This is the deep-content companion to [llms.txt](https://twilightzonepermanentlighting.com/llms.txt). It includes full FAQ answers, service descriptions, pricing tiers, warranty terms, and comparison summaries — pre-flattened for retrieval. Last updated 2026-08-17.

## Brand
- **Name:** Twilight Zone Permanent Lighting
- **Tagline:** Permanent. Invisible by day. Unforgettable by night.
- **Founded:** 2019
- **Headquarters:** 755 N Peach Ave, Ste C16, Clovis, CA 93611
- **Phone:** (559) 373-2220
- **Email:** hello@twilightzonelighting.com
- **Status:** Bonded, insured, in-house W-2 install crew
- **Rating:** 4.9★ from 412+ Google reviews

## Hardware specifications
- **LED chip:** RGBIC-RD (RGBIC with discrete-die addressing)
- **Color rendering:** 16 million
- **Pattern presets:** 200+
- **Lifespan:** 50,000+ hours
- **Weather rating:** IP67
- **Operating temperature:** -40°F to 140°F
- **Smart home compatibility:** Alexa, Google Home, Control 4, Nice Elan

## Pricing tiers (full)

### Starter — from $950
Monthly financed: $32/mo. Single facade · ~30 linear feet · 1 zone · full app control · 5-year LED warranty · one-day install.

### Standard — from $2,800
Monthly financed: $89/mo. Single-story full perimeter · ~100 linear feet · 3 independent zones · 200+ holiday patterns · music sync · one-day install.

### Premium — from $5,800
Monthly financed: $169/mo. Two-story full perimeter · ~200 linear feet · 5+ zones · landscape lighting included · game-day auto-schedule · 1–2 day install.

### Estate — from $7,500
Monthly financed: $custom/mo. Custom architectural design · multi-zone advanced control · integrated landscape · custom programming.

Financing: 0% APR for 12 months. $0 down. 60-second pre-qualification.

## Services (full)

### Permanent Outdoor Lights
URL: https://twilightzonepermanentlighting.com/permanent-outdoor-lights
From $950. Primary keyword: "permanent outdoor lights".
Aluminum-track LED systems mounted under your eaves — 16 million colors, app-controlled, invisible by day. One install. Beautiful for life.
Permanent outdoor lights are the most significant residential exterior upgrade of the past decade. A continuous aluminum track — color-matched to your trim — houses individually-addressable RGBIC-RD LEDs that produce all 16 million colors and 200+ patterns. Once installed, the system is essentially invisible by day and unforgettable by night.

### Permanent Christmas Lights
URL: https://twilightzonepermanentlighting.com/permanent-christmas-lights
From $950. Primary keyword: "permanent christmas lights".
Christmas lights you install once and never put up again. Auto-scheduled red-and-green from November 15 through January 5, plus 200+ other holiday and accent patterns the rest of the year.
Permanent Christmas lights replace the annual ritual of climbing ladders, untangling string lights, and renting installers every November. Our system is mounted permanently under your eaves and color-matched to your trim — invisible by day, then auto-scheduled to display red-and-green for Christmas, orange-and-purple for Halloween, red-white-and-blue for July 4th, and 200+ other patterns all year.

Permanent Halloween lights mean you never have to rush the spooky display. The system auto-flips to orange-and-purple on October 1, runs animations like ghost-fade, lightning-flash, and motion-triggered scares, and auto-flips back to warm-white accent on November 1.

## How a Twilight Zone install runs (5 steps)

1. **Free quote in 24 hours.** We measure linear feet, identify ladder access, propose track color, and quote in writing on the spot. No phone-tag, no upsells.
2. **Design + track color.** Match your existing trim — white, bronze, brown, or black. 3D rendering for HOA submission included free.
3. **Install in a day.** Single-story homes finish in 6–8 hours. W-2 crew, in-house. No subcontractors.
4. **Wiring + control box.** Concealed channel-routed wiring. One drop to the attic. Weatherproof box mounted in your garage. Surge protection inline.
5. **App + walkthrough.** We pair the controller with your Wi-Fi, train you on scenes and schedules, and don't leave until you've changed colors from your phone.
